title: Repair after a snap
turns: Can you help me figure out why my sourdough keeps coming out flat?
No, I already said I use a starter. Did you even read what I wrote? Never mind. Forget it.
Sorry. That was harsh. It's not about the bread. Bad day.
You don't have to be so nice about it. I was rude.
Okay. Yeah. So... the bread. Where were we?
Thanks. Actually, can I tell you what the bad day was about?
